description.value: Pho Vy is a Vietnamese restaurant in Victoria, BC, offering the warming, broth-based dishes that pho cuisine is known for. It sits in a city well-traveled by touring cyclists exploring Vancouver Island's southern tip. Cyclists stopping in Victoria would find Vietnamese cuisine a satisfying and affordable refueling option.
